x: Pat O'Connor led in the Belgrave squad followed by Lionel Mann, Clive Shippen and Brian Joines. John Hall motored up from Wales to compete and informed us that he is giving up his first claim on Belgrave and expecting an addition to his family.
Brian Joines passed Tony Brien in the latter stages to finish strongly whilst Geoff Pearson in his 22nd Poly improved on his time of last year by 4 mins-19secs (Ken Stimpson please note!!).
This was the half way mark (51:34) and supporting our key men were Clive Shippen (56:18), Brian Joines (60:49), Paul Pringle (60:49) and Jack Baker (62:03).

Turning his attention to the mud, also, was our road running member Brian Joines, who finished 287th in 42m. 55s. for Oxfordshire. Apart from winning the Senior race, Surrey took third place in the Youths' event.
Lionel won the race from Pat O'Connor, with our road running member Brian Joines taking fourth place for Oxford City, his first-claim club over the country.
